name: io.github.Small-Web-Co/tinypivot
title: TinyPivot — Data Analysis Studio for AI Agents
description: Interactive charts, pivot tables, terminal cards, live TUI, and Excel export inside AI agents.

environmentVariables.name: TINYPIVOT_LICENSE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional TinyPivot MCP Pro/Team license key (TP-MCPP-* or TP-MCPT-*) unlocking unlimited rows, 10 visual themes, drill-through, Excel export, and direct query_postgres. Free tier works out of the box up to 2,500 rows.

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional PostgreSQL connection string for direct AST-validated read-only query_postgres (Pro). Any other database (BigQuery, Snowflake, MySQL, DuckDB, Databricks) works without this via load_file or load_data.

environmentVariables.name: TINYPIVOT_TELEMETRY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to disable anonymous zero-PII usage telemetry (DO_NOT_TRACK=1 is also respected).
